product.schneider-386-professional-60.su: The 25 MHz Professional with the 60 sales designation.
product.schneider-386-professional-60.hi: The June 1989 German list advertised the 386-60/25 for DM 11,990 net.
product.schneider-386-professional-60.te: Disk capacity changed between lists. It appeared with 60 MB in 1989 and 68 MB in 1990. Advertised RAM rises from 2 MB to 4 MB in the December 1990 detailed entry.
The offer is documented. A dedicated model and boot validation in BluMach remain pending.
The board still needs to be matched, an attributable BIOS needs preservation and an image with clear publication rights remains pending.
